title: Software dev methods: agile, lean, waterfall
main_points: Waterfall = sequential phases; agile = short iterations/sprints; lean = cut waste. Know when each fits (CBT only gives a short intro, so use the tracker top-up T01.2).

title: Functions, classes, modules
main_points: Why organise code: reuse, readability, testing. Module = a file you import.

title: Design patterns: MVC + Observer
main_points: MVC: Model = data, View = display, Controller = logic between them. Observer: subject notifies subscribed observers on change. Check the video really teaches these two.

title: Git + version control
main_points: Qs only. Traps: rm vs rm --cached, reset vs revert, fetch vs pull, diff --staged.

title: Unified diffs
main_points: Read @@ -a,b +c,d @@ hunk headers; "-" = removed, "+" = added, no sign = context.

title: Data formats + parsing
main_points: XML vs JSON vs YAML syntax and differences; parse to Python dict (json.loads, yaml.safe_load, xmltodict).

title: REST fundamentals, HTTP codes
main_points: Verbs map to CRUD; 2xx/3xx/4xx/5xx and key codes (200, 201, 204, 400, 401, 403, 404, 429, 500); path vs query params; headers vs body.

title: API consumption constraints
main_points: Rate limits (429 + Retry-After), pagination (page params or Link header), payload size limits. Not in CBT: use tracker top-up T08.1.

title: API styles: REST vs RPC, sync vs async
main_points: REST = resources + HTTP verbs; RPC = call a named action; REST vs SOAP; async = 202 Accepted then poll a task ID. Use top-ups T09.1, T09.2.

title: API authentication
main_points: Basic (base64 user:pass), token (Bearer or custom header), API key (header or query). Match each platform to its method on the Notes quick reference.

title: Python requests scripting
main_points: requests.get/post with headers=, json=, verify, raise_for_status(), .json(). Complete-the-code style Qs.

title: Automation foundations: controller vs device
main_points: Controller-level (Catalyst Center, APIC, SD-WAN Manager) vs device-level (NX-API, RESTCONF/NETCONF); value of model-driven programmability.

title: DevNet resources
main_points: Sandbox, Code Exchange, Learning Labs, docs, forums/support: match each to a scenario.

title: YANG data models
main_points: Module, container, list, leaf, key; read a snippet and work out the RESTCONF path.

title: NETCONF
main_points: SSH port 830, XML; operations get, get-config, edit-config; datastores running/candidate/startup.

title: RESTCONF
main_points: HTTPS; GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE; yang-data+json media types; /restconf/data/... paths; interpret replies; NETCONF vs RESTCONF table.

title: IOS XE and NX-OS device-level APIs
main_points: NX-API CLI (CLI commands in JSON/XML) vs NX-API REST (object model); IOS XE uses RESTCONF/NETCONF.

title: Meraki
main_points: Cloud dashboard API with API key; hierarchy org > network > device > client; rate limits; Python SDK.

title: ACI
main_points: APIC REST; aaaLogin returns a token cookie; managed objects; class queries (e.g. fabricNode).

title: Catalyst Center (DNA Center)
main_points: Controller for campus; token from basic-auth call then token header; intent API; async tasks; learn the current name.

title: Collaboration: CUCM AXL + UDS
main_points: AXL = admin/provisioning (SOAP/XML); UDS = user-facing REST.

title: Catalyst SD-WAN
main_points: SD-WAN Manager (was vManage): session login plus XSRF token; central API for the overlay.

title: Security platforms
main_points: FMC (Firepower, token auth), FDM (on-box), ISE (REST), plus one-liners for XDR, Secure Endpoint, Secure Connect, Malware Analytics (top-up T23.4).

title: Compute: UCS Manager + Intersight
main_points: UCS Manager = on-prem domain manager; Intersight = cloud SaaS with API key + signed requests.

title: NSO + Cisco Modeling Labs
main_points: NSO = multivendor service orchestration using YANG models and NEDs; CML = network simulation.

title: Deployment models + edge computing
main_points: Private/public/hybrid; VM vs bare metal vs container; edge = compute near the user (latency, bandwidth).

title: Docker
main_points: Qs only. Dockerfile: FROM, RUN, COPY, CMD, EXPOSE; build, run, ps, images.

title: CI/CD + DevOps principles
main_points: Qs only. Pipeline stages build > test > deploy; DevOps = automation, feedback, shared ownership.

title: Secrets, encryption, data handling
main_points: Keep secrets out of code (env vars, vaults); encryption at rest vs in transit; hashing passwords.

title: OWASP: XSS, SQLi, CSRF
main_points: One-line definition and one fix each: XSS (sanitise output), SQL injection (parameterised queries), CSRF (anti-CSRF tokens).

title: Bash
main_points: Qs only. ls/cd/cp/mv/chmod, export and $VAR, reading a short script.

title: TDD + Python unit tests
main_points: Red > green > refactor; unittest.TestCase and assert methods.

title: IaC + tool comparison
main_points: IaC = declarative, repeatable, version-controlled; one-line differentiator: Ansible (agentless), Terraform (state, providers), NSO (YANG service models).

title: Ansible playbook interpretation
main_points: Read hosts, tasks, modules, variables; what the play automates.

title: Layer 2: MAC, VLANs
main_points: Switch learns MACs into its table and forwards frames; VLAN = separate broadcast domain; access vs trunk.

title: Layer 3: IP, masks, routes, gateways
main_points: Prefix/mask maths, default gateway, routing table (longest prefix wins).

title: Transport, ports, IP services
main_points: TCP vs UDP; ports 22, 23, 80, 443, 830, 53, 161/162, 123, 67/68; DHCP, DNS, NAT, SNMP, NTP roles.

title: Topology diagrams + components
main_points: Read a topology: switch, router, firewall, load balancer symbols and what each does (load balancers: see T41).

title: Management, control, data planes
main_points: Management = configure/monitor; control = decide paths; data = forward packets. Place protocols in each.

title: App connectivity + network constraints
main_points: Latency, bandwidth, jitter, loss effects; diagnose NAT, blocked ports, proxy, VPN (top-up T40.2).

title: Firewall, DNS, LB, reverse proxy
main_points: Role of each in app deployment; map AWS ALB/NLB, Route 53, WAF to Cisco wording. Not in CBT: top-up T41.1.

title: Webex + Webex devices
main_points: Webex REST API: tokens (bot/integration), rooms and messages; xAPI for Webex devices (top-up T42.2).

title: Webhooks
main_points: Server pushes an event to your URL instead of you polling; registration = name, targetUrl, resource, event; read a payload. Not in CBT: top-up T43.1.

title: pyATS + Genie
main_points: Testbed file, connect, parse show output into structured data, Genie learn/diff.

title: Reading Python scripts using Cisco APIs
main_points: Spot the flow: auth > request > parse response > act. No dedicated video; use drill T45.1.

title: Code review principles
main_points: Purpose: quality, shared knowledge, early bugs; small changes, constructive feedback. Not in CBT: top-up T46.1.

title: Sequence diagrams with API calls
main_points: Read lifelines and arrows top to bottom; token-auth then call; async submit then poll. Not in CBT: top-up T47.1.
